verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The exact fiber equality is a WBC-specific response-function specialization, while the advertised maximal identification subclass is characterized only by equality of extrema of that feasible image, not by a new observable or computational criterion. The broad identification envelope assumes the load-bearing latent-valid bridge intersection and two proposal-specific latent transport restrictions, so it does not characterize identification on the published WBC model. The calibrated escape from completeness is confined to affine/common-shock structure with those transport restrictions still assumed, and its sole explicit success law has constant outcome and mediator risks, making the demonstrated identification especially weak. The row-span converse remains open even on the positive observed-law interior, so the note delivers narrow sufficient branches, an exact counterexample, and a formal fiber representation rather than the stronger identification frontier suggested by its maximal-class framing.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Resolve the positive-interior obstruction by proving that every strictly positive feasible law with a nonzero-loading bridge null direction admits two canonical feasible points with unequal targets. The construction must perturb the response-law parameter together with the bridge while preserving the observed law, product factorization, overlap, and latent bridge equations.
